paragraphs: Hero bets $100. He is risking $100 to win $200. He needs Villain :, fold 33% of the time to break even. Villain has to defend 67% of the time to prevent Hero from profitably bluffing with any two cards. Hero bet the river assuming that Villain would fail to meet minimum defense frequency
unlikely to stab the turn. Why give him a free card?
